responsibility: This header centralizes MIPS option-related enumerations and special option constants used across the backend and driver. It defines enums for settings such as -mcode-readable, -mabs/-mnan, -mr10k-cache-barrier, and -mcompact-branches, as well as the sentinel values for special -march choices like from-abi and native, providing the shared type definitions consumed by mips.opt, target headers, and implementation code.
